metadata.method: Symbolless REA: ELF section parsing, JNI export cataloging, ADRP+ADD/LDR precomputed-index string cross-reference scan, BL target reverse-xref map, jump-table identification.

section_layout.note: Vaddr/Section info from lief. Text at 0x64c64e0 = 200 MB of stripped ARM64 code; .rodata at 0x2311800 = 20 MB of debug strings, diagnostic messages, and lambda typeinfo names.

jni_surface.note: All 5 MainActivity lifecycle exports (nativeResize, nativeSuspend, nativeSuspendGameplayUpdates, nativeStopThis, nativeOnDestroy) at 0x852e328-0x852e348 share an identical 3-call dispatcher prologue: bl 0xe496620 → bl 0xe496624 → bl 0xe4a2214. This is the canonical AppPlatform lifecycle path — all 5 JNI exports funnel through the same 3 jump tables before reaching engine code.

legacy_mangled_status.conclusion: All 9 mangled names from minecraft-symbols 1.13/1.14 are absent from libminecraftpe.so 1.26.52.3 dynsym. Mojang switched to hidden-visibility compile flags between 1.16 (RenderDragon intro) and 1.26 — the engine classes no longer appear in dynsym, but their string identifiers DO remain in .rodata (MinecraftGame 838 occurrences, RenderContext 818, LevelRenderer 129, AppPlatform 101, setRenderingSize 2, RenderDragon 23).

0xe496620.type: branch table indexed by lifecycle event
0xe496620.notes: Called from 0x64c98c4 which loads function pointer from [x20 + x22*8 + 0x18] then branches via table[event_code].

0xe496624.notes: Parallel dispatch for second lifecycle phase.

0xe4a2214.notes: Called from 0x6d5ba18 alongside ldr [x23,#0x48] + add #0xb0 — loads AppPlatform* from this->vtable[0x48]+0xb0, then calls into this table.

0xe49ebb0.notes: Branch table indexed by severity code (5 → 0x12920150, etc). The 0x8534534 code calls this with (severity=5, 'Minecraft', 'MinecraftGame::init && MinecraftGame::setSize!') — this is the assertion/log dispatcher, not a direct hook target.

real_engine_code_region.note: All jump table entries (0xe496620, 0xe496624, 0xe4a2214, 0xe49ebb0) point into 0x12900000-0x12a00000 — this is where the actual engine lifecycle handlers, setRenderingSize, tick, render-loop code live. To hook these we need to (a) disassemble specific table entries once we know which event/slot triggers setSize, and (b) trace the chain from Java_* JNI exports through the jump tables into that region.

engine_strings_evidence.method: Binary search for substrings in .rodata, then ADRP+ADD/LDR precomputed-index scan over .text to find which code references those substrings. Index built once (8.9s, 9628 pages, 1.6M ADRPs), lookup O(1) per string.

key_findings.context: Function at 0x8534534 calls LogAssert (via 0xe49ebb0) with severity=5, tag='Minecraft', msg=this substring. This is an assertion in the MinecraftGame::setSize() path — implies setSize() was called before init().

Likely used as typeinfo name or exception message; not directly addressable via symbol lookup. Exists in .rodata but compiler emits references through indirect means (possibly exception tables, .gcc_except_table).

This is the typeinfo name of the lambda created inside setRenderingSize(int,int). Its presence CONFIRMS App::setRenderingSize(int,int) exists as a function in the binary, even though the mangled symbol _ZN3App16setRenderingSizeEii is absent from dynsym. The lambda address is held in the AppPlatform vtable.
Engine bootstrap method; called once at startup.

Function at 0xb9694b8 references 'AppPlatform' (11 bytes) and calls 0x129118d0 / 0x12911a90 / 0x1290e3a8 / 0x1290a19c — all in the engine code region. This is a likely AppPlatform teardown/disposal function (freeing linked-list nodes).

Function 0x98f6c10 is a MinecraftGame factory: it copies 'MinecraftGame'+27 bytes (likely 'MinecraftGame::init' or qualified type) to stack, calls e4c2a7c (memcpy), then e4c2864 (factory helper), then e496718 (jump table entry in 0xe496620 — slot 9), then stores the result into [x19,#0x15f8]. x19 is likely the AppPlatform singleton; offset 0x15f8 is the MinecraftGame pointer field.
JNI bridge callback name. The actual JNI export is Java_com_mojang_minecraftpe_MainActivity_nativeResize at 0x852e348 — the C++ side delegates into the engine through the onSurfaceChangedNative path.
JNI bridge callback for surface creation.

resolved_symbols_for_mcbedvr.note: These are the addresses that can be hooked from mcbedvr's ResolveGameSymbols() given the current evidence. Marked 'confirmed' if verified via multiple sources; 'candidate' if single-source.

MinecraftGame_ctor.evidence: Factory/init function referencing 'MinecraftGame' string at 0x2342d40 + 27 bytes. Calls operator new(0xf0) and stores into [x19, #0x15f8].

MinecraftGame_tick.evidence: MinecraftGame::onTick() and MinecraftGame::update() strings exist at 0x23d9e1f and 0x2494807 but no direct ADRP+ADD/LDR xref found. Likely called through jump table 0xe496620 entry that needs further tracing.

App_setRenderingSize.evidence: Lambda typeinfo name 'setRenderingSizeEiiE3$_0' at 0x2c017c0 confirms the function exists in the binary. Recommended hook point: the jump table entry in 0xe496620 that the 5 lifecycle JNIs funnel through, OR nativeResize (0x852e348) as a JNI-side trampoline.

App_setUISizeAndScale.evidence: No occurrences in .rodata; function may be inlined or removed.

mce_Platform_OGL_InitBindings.evidence: No 'mce::' substrings in .rodata. RenderDragon (1.16+) replaced mce::Platform::OGL with RenderDragonInternal.

mce_Platform_OGL_SwapBuffers.evidence: Same as above; RenderDragon swap is internal.

MinecraftGame_handleInput.evidence: Likely routed through onInputDeviceAddedNative (0x85326ec) which calls 0xe4a2214 (lifecycle table 3) then BLRs via register path.

GameControllerManager_register.evidence: setControllerDetailsNative (0x85328b8) calls 0xe4a2214 then 0xe49ebb0 (input dispatcher). 'GameControllerManager' string exists at 0x35f9c8e but no direct xref.

LevelRendererPlayer_render.evidence: Function references 'LevelRenderer' string; candidate LevelRenderer operation (constructor, init, or render method).

LevelRenderer_draw.evidence: Same as above; needs deeper chain tracing.

next_actions: Patch Symbols.cpp to fall back to JNI-export offsets when dlsym fails — nativeResize (0x852e348) is the canonical setRenderingSize hook surface.
Build a runtime cross-reference walker: from JNI export, follow BL chain through jump tables into 0x12900000-0x12a00000 engine region and identify the actual setSize target.
Disassemble the JNI surface between 0x852e000-0x8530000 in full and identify which 5 lifecycle JNI exports map to which jump-table slot.
Re-run on a Bedrock 1.20.x APK (if available) to confirm whether App::setRenderingSize is still in dynsym there; if so, dual-version Symbols.cpp with conditional compilation.
